title: Augmented internal homogeneous bar resolution
statement:
Let $A$ be a commutative condensed ring on a small site of profinite sets with finite jointly surjective coverings [sk-def-sfb-condensed-ring, def-weil-size-convention]. Let $G$ be a profinite group, and write $\underline G(S)=C(S,G)$ for its condensed group. Work with internal $A$-modules [sk-def-sfb-module-objects], and with $A$-linear actions of $\underline G$ and equivariant module morphisms. For a condensed set $X$, let $A[X]$ denote the free internal $A$-module, the left adjoint of the forgetful functor to condensed sets. Define $P_n=A[\underline G^{n+1}]$ for $n\geq0$, with diagonal left $G$-action, and let $A$ have trivial action. The augmentation $\epsilon:P_0\to A$ sends each generator $[g]$ to $1$. For $n\geq1$ set
$$\partial_n[g_0,\ldots,g_n]=\sum_{i=0}^{n}(-1)^i[g_0,\ldots,\widehat{g_i},\ldots,g_n].$$
These are morphisms of internal equivariant modules, satisfy $\epsilon\partial_1=0$ and $\partial_n\partial_{n+1}=0$, and the augmented complex $\cdots\to P_1\to P_0\to A\to0$ is exact. More generally, for every internal $A$-module $T$, with trivial $G$-action, the augmented complex obtained by tensoring over $A$ with $T$ is exact. Here tensor is the internal module tensor product, and exactness means equality of the image and kernel subobjects, including surjectivity of the augmentation. Under the continuous change of coordinates
$$(g_0,\ldots,g_n)\longleftrightarrow(g_0,g_0^{-1}g_1,g_1^{-1}g_2,\ldots,g_{n-1}^{-1}g_n),$$
the object $P_n$ is the induced equivariant module $A[\underline G]\otimes_A A[\underline G^n]$, where $G$ acts by left translation on the first factor only. No categorical projectivity of $A[\underline G^n]$ is asserted.
